title: Unveiling the ConFoo 2024 edition!
content: With over , delivered by speakers from around the world, ConFoo is a conference for Full-Stack developers covering everything from the backend to the frontend: JavaScript, PHP, Java, Dotnet, Security, Artificial Intelligence, DevOps, and much more. ConFoo brings an outstanding diversity of content to expand your knowledge, increase your productivity, and take your development skills to the next level. With a selection of presentations focused on cutting-edge technologies, there's a reason why attendees returning from ConFoo say they've learned more in these 3 days than in 3 years at university! Register now to participate, who contribute to the Open Source projects you use every day. 170 presentationsmeet renowned speakers
